title: TypeError when evaluating similarity model on A100 GPUs using EmbeddingSimilarityEvaluator (works on CPU)
author: joaograndotto

comments.author: tomaarsen
comments.body:
Hello!

I believe this is a recent issue caused by the `datasets` v4.0 release, which was resolved in #3455. You can avoid this issue in one of two ways:
* Use the `master` version of Sentence Transformers: `pip install git+https://UKPLab/sentence-transformers.git`
* Don't use `datasets` v4.0: `pip install -U datasets<4.0`

If you give one of these a try, feel free to let me know if it works for you.

- Tom Aarsen

comments.author: joaograndotto
comments.body: @tomaarsen  It worked, I made both changes and it worked, thank you very much!

comments.author: tomaarsen
comments.body:
Awesome, glad to hear it! I'll bring out a release soon so that others don't have to install from source or downgrade packages anymore.

- Tom Aarsen
